title: route.sight
description: Wild Routes (WR5): a zone trainer saw the player. The client holds the player still, shows "!" over the trainer's puppet for 60 frames, then walks it to the cell in front of the player; the server's route.battle follows.

x.description: The cell the trainer walks to, in the zone's route-map grid.

frames.description: Gen 1 frames (60 a second) of the walk after the "!"; 0 when the trainer already stands in front of the player.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
